lines.zh: 我一步一步走过被腐蚀的土地。
lines.en: I cross the corroded ground step by step.
Green smoke rises at my feet.
My train is rotting hide.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，酸液滴下来。
lines.en: I raise a hand and acid drips.
The grass I tread withers.
I walk slowly, as if inspecting.

lines.zh: 我的身体一半是金属，一半是肉。
lines.en: Half of me is metal, half flesh.
I turn my face; the mask catches light.

lines.zh: 我经过一堵墙，墙开始腐。
lines.en: I pass a wall and it begins to rot.
I stop in the middle of the village.

lines.zh: 我站着，酸液从指缝里滴。
lines.en: I stand, acid dripping from my fingers.
The air sours around me.

lines.zh: 我提着手，看它一点点烂。
lines.en: I hold it up and watch it rot.
This body is constantly falling apart.
And constantly rebuilding.
My breathing sounds like a leak.
I lift my face and sniff the air.

lines.zh: 活着的东西，味道都很好。
lines.en: Living things all smell good.
I settle and blink slowly.
The crown makes my neck ache.
I reach up and straighten it.

lines.zh: 草已经枯了，这片地归我。
lines.en: The grass is dead. This land is mine.
Or rather, mine to corrode.
I'll wait for them to rot.
I do not hurry; rot comes on its own.

lines.zh: 我把手贴在墙上，墙在退。
lines.en: I lay a hand on the wall and it recedes.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，面具有些裂。
lines.en: I look down at you; the mask is cracked.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你站得很远。
lines.en: I look down. You're standing far off.
However far you stand, it won't help.
I point at the ground.
It's turning green there.

lines.zh: 我指指你脚下的地，你慌忙退开。
lines.en: I point at the ground under you. You hurry back.

lines.zh: 脚下那片泛出绿来，正合我意。
lines.en: Green spreads under you. Just as I wanted.
You know what to fear.
As I speak, you hold your breath.
Yet it sours the air.
You're still looking at my face.

lines.zh: 你竟还盯着我的面具，我很受用。
lines.en: You're still staring at my mask. I like that.
The fallen flesh twitches once.
Green fluid runs out.

lines.zh: 绿水从裂口淌下，我倒退少许。
lines.en: Green runs from the split. I ease back.
This body is failing again.

lines.zh: 身子又崩了一处，我拿手压住。
lines.en: Another part fails. I press it shut.

lines.zh: 酸把我自己的手也烧了。
lines.en: The acid burns my own hand.

lines.zh: 酸烧到我自己的手，我没有出声。
lines.en: The acid burns my own hand. I make no sound.

lines.zh: 裂缝自己合上了，我不疼。
lines.en: The crack closes itself; I feel nothing.
Good. I can still walk.

lines.zh: 创口一点点收拢，你确实伤到了我。
lines.en: The wound closes. You did hurt me.

lines.zh: 你拿来的东西，会被腐蚀。
lines.en: Whatever you bring will corrode.
I don't eat what you bring.
I only need them to rot.

lines.zh: 我说话的时候，你的手在抖。
lines.en: As I speak, your hand shakes.
Stop holding it. Put it down.
Look, it's already changing color.

lines.zh: 它已经开始变色，这就是我。
lines.en: It's already changing color. That's what I am.
Sooner or later, you too.

lines.zh: 你身上也会生绿斑，早晚而已。
lines.en: Green will find you too. Sooner or later.

lines.zh: 日子越久我越占便宜，不必催。
lines.en: Time favors me. No need to rush.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，衣服开始起皱。
lines.en: You hit me and your clothes start to pucker.

lines.zh: 衣服起皱了，不是皱，是腐。
lines.en: Your clothes pucker. Not wrinkled. Rotted.
You hit me. I didn't move.
You snatch your hand back.
I look down at your hand.
There's a spot of green on the skin.

lines.zh: 你皮上沾了绿斑，搓也搓不掉。
lines.en: A green spot on your skin. It won't rub off.

lines.zh: 我瞥一眼你的手，接着前行。
lines.en: I glance at your hand and walk on.
I walk on. You'd better keep up.
Keep up, or it gets worse.
The throne needs only one.
My body is always failing.
Repair is easier than rebuilding.
I raise it and watch the wound close.

lines.zh: 我提手看着它长好，再崩开。
lines.en: I watch it knit, then split again.
Ruin, mend, repeat.

lines.zh: 裂了又长，长完再裂，只有我。
lines.en: Split, regrow, split again. Only me.
No one else. Nor do I need anyone.

lines.zh: 看着它裂开，我把手放下。
lines.en: Watching it split, I lower my hand.
My hand falls. Keep walking.

lines.zh: 我指尖一碰，它就开始化。
lines.en: One touch of my fingertip and it starts to melt.

lines.zh: 夹起来的那块，它开始冒烟。
lines.en: What I pinched starts to smoke.
Soon it has no shape.

lines.zh: 它转眼没了轮廓，我松手。
lines.en: It loses its shape. I let it go.
A green patch remains.
I don't need things.
I only need space.
This land is changing.
I can hear it splitting.

lines.zh: 地上积了一汪绿水，很好看。
lines.en: A pool of green on the ground. Lovely.
You're standing there. Perfect.

lines.zh: 绿色从指间流出，我抬起手。
lines.en: Green runs from my fingers. I raise my hand.

lines.zh: 绿色从我的指尖流下去。
lines.en: Green flows from my fingertips.
The green flows down and the ground hisses.

lines.zh: 你看见地上的印子，往后退。
lines.en: You see the mark. You back away.

lines.zh: 但你踩过的地方已经有印子了。
lines.en: But your footprints are already marked.
I wait. You look down.

lines.zh: 你踩过的地方，对，就是那儿。
lines.en: Where you trod. Yes. Right there.

lines.zh: 我指的不是那块地，是你本身。
lines.en: Not the spot. You.
Not where you stand.

lines.zh: 我要带走的不是那块地，是你。
lines.en: It isn’t the ground I want. It’s you.
Every step leaves a mark.
This world is rotting.
You're just earlier than most.
Nowhere to hide. Don't be afraid.
I raise my hand. It'll be gentle.
Listen. Corrosion is quiet.
Not a sound. Listen.
The grass dies under you. You're running.

lines.zh: 你跑过的地方，草都死了。
lines.en: The grass dies where you run.
No. That's what I left.

lines.zh: 那摊绿是我的手笔，你正踩着。
lines.en: That green is my work. You're standing in it.
It climbs your boots.

lines.zh: 绿痕爬过你的鞋面，你停住脚。
lines.en: It climbs your boot. You stop walking.
You've stopped. You look down.
Now you understand.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪里都带着它，我不用追。
lines.en: You carry it wherever you run. I needn't chase.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪里都会带着它。
lines.en: Wherever you run, you carry it.

lines.zh: 我裙摆拖在地上，慢慢走。
lines.en: My train drags the ground. I walk slowly.
My train drags on the ground.
Everything on the ground is changing.

lines.zh: 脚下的东西都在烂，树也歪了。
lines.en: Everything is rotting. The trees lean.
The trees lean. The walls give.
You hear it and look back.

lines.zh: 我没有快走，我就在后面。
lines.en: I haven't hurried. I'm right behind.
I trail behind, never far.
Close, but I don't need to touch you.

lines.zh: 你已经带着它了，已经够了。
lines.en: You're already carrying it. That's enough.
My palm touches skin, and it rots.
Where you blocked, the rot begins.
Green mist wraps around you.

lines.zh: 你护甲上起了一层绿泡。
lines.en: Green blisters rise on your armor.

lines.zh: 我的手臂伸过去，你躲开。
lines.en: My arm reaches out; you dodge.
I follow two steps.
My arm splits.
I brace with the other.

lines.zh: 我上前两步，你又往后躲。
lines.en: Two steps in, and you retreat again.
You backed off. That's good.
I don't need to hit you.
I only need you to stay here.
And slowly rot.

lines.zh: 我犯不着碰你，等着就行。
lines.en: I don't need to touch you. I'll just wait.
I rise out of the ground.

lines.zh: 脚下的土已经是绿色的。
lines.en: The soil under me is already green.
I raise my hand and examine it.
Skin sloughs; new skin grows.

lines.zh: 我能听见很远的地方在烂。
lines.en: I can hear rot far away.
This place is very clean.
Clean enough to want to spoil.
I walk a few steps.
The grass withers at my feet.
Bark begins to peel.
The grass withers underfoot. I raise my head.
Someone lives here.
I can smell them.

lines.zh: 看出有人烟，我转向村子。
lines.en: Signs of people. I turn toward the village.
The crown is light on my head.

lines.zh: 王冠轻得像没有，我还是扶正了。
lines.en: The crown weighs nothing. I straighten it anyway.
This will be mine.

lines.zh: 这地方迟早姓我，用不了多久。
lines.en: This place will be mine. Not long now.
I smile beneath the mask.
The lips under the mask split open.
Fire dries me out and the skin splits.

lines.zh: 落地时我半边身子散了。
lines.en: On landing, half of me comes apart.
Water dilutes my acid.

lines.zh: 爆炸撕掉了我的半边裙。
lines.en: The blast tears away half my train.

lines.zh: 弹丸穿过我，孔里在冒烟。
lines.en: A round passes through; the hole smokes.

lines.zh: 光锁住我的腐蚀，我退了。
lines.en: Light halts the corrosion and I retreat.

lines.zh: 没有东西可烂，我就空了。
lines.en: Nothing left to rot, I run empty.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，绿色的火星乱跳。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and green sparks fly.

lines.zh: 这里没有地，酸也没得腐。
lines.en: No ground here, nothing even for acid to rot.
